title: 傳炸彈遊戲
question:
n 個人排成一圈玩傳炸彈，編號 1 到 n，炸彈從 1 號開始。每傳一次，炸彈就交給下一個人；傳了 k 次之後，拿著炸彈的人出局，炸彈從下一個人重新開始傳。一直玩到只剩一個人。
請輸入 n、k，依序輸出出局的人，最後輸出「最後留下 幾號」。

en.title: Hot Potato
en.question:
n people stand in a circle, numbered 1 to n. The potato starts with person 1. Each pass gives it to the next person. After k passes, the person holding it is out, and the next person starts again. Play until one person is left.
Input n and k. Output the people who are out, in order. At the end, output "Winner: " and the number.
